description: Ministry of Education - Duties & functions assigned to the State Minister of Education
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Minister Akila Viraj Kariyawasam) and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities assigned to the State Minister of Education, including specific functions and duties across multiple subject areas (estate sector schools, Northern/Eastern provinces, international schools, special needs education, language education, and teacher training). This meets the criteria for Hybrid Gazette (Type 3) as it contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios).
